title: Plate reader growth curve QC

author.name: S08
author.field: Microbiology (antibiotic susceptibility of E. coli efflux mutants)

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: The plate is synthetic and generated in the page from a seeded random number generator: logistic curves with noise, plus four planted problems (bubble spikes in B3 and E7, a missed no-drug well D1, a contaminated blank G12). Fits are a four-parameter logistic by Levenberg-Marquardt in plain JS; lag is the tangent-at-inflection lag. Exclusions are not saved between visits.
